 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Manchester City need to get back to winning ways in the Premier League after last weekend's defeat. They will look to do so against a Brighton side coming off a loss to Liverpool.
 Today's match at the Etihad Stadium features these lineups:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Manchester City : Khusanov, Dias (C), Gvardiol, Bouaddi, Anderson, Fernández, Ndiaye, Doku, Haaland.
 Cherki returns to the bench alongside Foden, Lewis and Guehi. Khusanov joins Nunes at the back, Bouaddi is in midfield and Haaland leads the attack.
 Brighton & Hove Albion : Verbruggen; Costinha, Dunk, Vuskovic, Boscagli; Gross, Chema Andrés; Diego Gómez, Ayari, De Cuyper; Kostoulas.
